feeds.title: Sugar-Free Mom
feeds.description: Read about Naturally Sugar-Free, Keto, Low Carb Recipes and Meal Plan. Brenda Bennett, a popular food blogger Sugar Free Mom, knows what it's like to struggle with sugar and carb addiction and what it's like to be doing keto alone without her husband following the diet. She's found freedom in the keto lifestyle and the ability to make recipes the whole family will eat. No need to cook differently for your kids and make separate meals for yourself.

feeds.title: Queen Keto
feeds.description: Discover clean eating, low carb, sugar free recipes for the ketogenic diet. Delicious savoury dishes and sweet treats the keto way. Antya has always been passionate about great food, with a particular fondness for Italian cuisine.

feeds.title: Mom Secrets
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Carla, the founder of MomSecrets.co. Cooking is my passion and my family is always looking forward to the new surprising recipes. So, I always invent new recipes to surprise them, at least every weekend they can try an unusual dessert or a meal I've never done before. I'm so glad to share my keto, low carb recipes with you! This is my passion and (people say) my talent as well, so I hope if you try to cook some of my recipes, your families will be happy too!

feeds.title: The Busy Mom Blog » Keto
feeds.description: Find the latest information and updates on the keto diet at The Busy Mom Blog.

feeds.title: Keto In The City Blog
feeds.description: Keto In The City is dedicated to helping others live a ketogenic lifestyle. Jen Fisch created Keto In The City as a way to share keto-friendly recipes and tips on how to live a low carb lifestyle.

feeds.title: The Kellie Kitchen » Keto
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Kellie. After years of gut issues and yo-yo dieting I finally figured out that I'd been doing it all wrong. With trial and error, lots of cooking and intense research on myself I learned (in my mid 40s) lifestyle techniques using whole foods and clean products that are easy to use and brought me to my best health. I'm on a tireless journey to create and share amazing low carb and Keto friendly foods with you.

feeds.title: Paleo Running Momma » Keto
feeds.description: Hi! I'm so happy you stopped by! My name is Michele and I'm a Paleo eater and recipe creator, runner, mom of 3, and the gal behind Paleo Running Momma! Over here you'll find real-food, clean eating, keto, low carb recipes that you'll be excited to share with your loved ones. I hope you stay awhile, eat, savor, and enjoy!

feeds.title: Hey Keto Mama
feeds.description: At Hey Keto Mama we create simple low carb recipes that make you want to jump-start or stick to your ketogenic lifestyle. Whether you're new to keto or have been rocking the low carb lifestyle for a long time, I'm glad you stopped by! The website is to inspire those following a ketogenic lifestyle and share my personal journey and experiences.

feeds.title: Cook At Home Mom » Low Carb / Keto
feeds.description: Welcome, I'm Laura! I have three little awesome kids who work really hard to keep me on my toes, and who are my inspiration every single day. I love sharing approachable, delicious meals, and I'm passionate about whole foods. Here you'll find mostly Whole30, Paleo, Keto and Low Carb recipes, with a little food freedom, too!

feeds.title: Nutricia KetoCal Blog
feeds.description: KetoConnect is a resource for parents of children on a ketogenic diet for intractable epilepsy, brought to you by Nutricia, the makers of KetoCal. The purpose KetoConnect is to keep keto moms and dads informed with the latest news and events, while providing useful tips, recipe ideas and resources to support you in managing your child's ketogenic diet.
